name: Audio Manager Pro
blocker: Current candidate adds live-refresh-safe Property Inspector editing, larger hardware key labels, and bundled standard/MK.2, XL, Plus, and Neo Stream Deck layouts. Exact-head automated QA must be green, then the remaining gate is physical target-machine validation of edit persistence, bundled-profile import/deduplication, audio switching, Stream Deck+ controls, restart/reboot/sleep-wake recovery, and demo evidence when required.
release_gate: XENEON Audio Control Center regression build
locked dependency audit and full fixture tests
Property Inspector transport + stale-refresh draft regression
canonical PackRat Property Inspector design audit
major-device bundled profile generation + ActionID uniqueness
Stream Deck key visual audit with major-profile coverage
physical Windows audio-device and Stream Deck Plus smoke
real-hardware Marketplace demonstration video when required
Stream Deck sleep/wake action and Property Inspector event smoke
read-only Audio Manager host audit at meaningful diagnostic/final checkpoints
final_boundary: Prior native/audio host evidence is healthy, but the product boundary changed after hardware QA exposed Property Inspector save/render races, unreadably small key text, and the absence of bundled Stream Deck layout profiles. Prior qa_passed evidence is historical only until the new exact-head CI and physical smoke pass.

current_scope: PI unsaved profile drafts survive 1.5-second live Windows refresh
pending action settings survive stale didReceiveSettings until acknowledgement
profile name, accent, endpoint and restore-state edits are protected until Save
hardware key glyphs moved upward with larger role/device text
standard/MK.2, XL, Plus and Neo Stream Deck layout profiles generated deterministically
Rat Dev opens the standard/MK.2 profile and uses semantic installed-profile deduplication
canonical PackRat dark/orange PI and key semantics
